# Vanta Haven

> Automated WhatsApp assistants and websites for small businesses in the Maldives.

Vanta Haven builds AI assistants that answer a business's customers on WhatsApp instantly,
using only that business's own information: menu, prices, opening hours, delivery areas,
airport transfers and similar. Replies are in Dhivehi or English, matching the customer.
The assistant never invents prices, never confirms bookings and never takes payments —
anything it cannot answer is handed to a person. Matching websites with the same
assistant embedded are built on request.

## Business

- Location: Malé, Maldives
- Contact: vantahaven@gmail.com
- Hours: Sunday–Thursday, 9am–6pm (Malé time)
- Model: one-off setup fee plus a monthly retainer; quotes depend on message volume

## Pages

- [Home](https://vantahaven.mv/): what the assistant does, what it answers, how it works, FAQ, demo request form
- [Privacy Policy](https://vantahaven.mv/privacy): how visitor enquiries and clients' customer conversations are handled
- [Terms of Service](https://vantahaven.mv/terms): scope of service, responsibilities, fees, liability

## Key facts

- The assistant runs on its own WhatsApp number; the client's existing number keeps working as before
- A working demo with the client's real menu is usually ready in about two weeks; going live takes longer because of Meta's business verification
- Clients own their content and their customer conversations; conversation data is never sold, shared between clients, or used to train AI models
